    SELECT lt.XCL_044 AS driver_id

      AND lt.XCL_048 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY lt.XCL_048 ASC
    LIMIT 1

INNER JOIN races AS r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2010
  AND d.XCL_034 = (SELECT driver_id FROM fastest_2010)
GROUP BY d.XCL_034

WITH fastest_2010 AS (
    SELECT lt.XCL_044 AS driver_id
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    INNER JOIN races AS r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2010
      AND lt.XCL_048 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY lt.XCL_048 ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, AVG(lt.XCL_048) / 1000.0 AS avg_fastest_lap_time_seconds
FROM drivers AS d
INNER JOIN lapTimes AS lt ON d.XCL_034 = lt.XCL_044
INNER JOIN races AS r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2010
  AND d.XCL_034 = (SELECT driver_id FROM fastest_2010)
